name: voiceforge-ai
description: VoiceForge AI — Lovable-style AI voice calling agent builder (monorepo).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @voiceforge/api exec nodemon" "pnpm --filter @voiceforge/web exec next dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @voiceforge/shared exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/web exec next build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @voiceforge/shared exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/ui exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/api exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/livekit-agent exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter voice-edge exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/web exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @voiceforge/api exec eslint "src/**/*.ts" && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/web exec eslint app components lib middleware.ts middleware-utils.ts next.config.ts
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @voiceforge/shared exec vitest run && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/api exec vitest run && pnpm --filter @voiceforge/livekit-agent exec vitest run
